## Description

Applies rough path signature feature embeddings over multi-scale order flow paths, feeding continuous tensor streams into multivariate Hawkes point processes for high-frequency price jump and liquidity shock forecasting.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book liquidity shock forecasting, tick-level flash crash detection.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Statistical Arbitrage Prop Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message feeds, trade execution timestamps, quote cancellation logs.

## Caveats

Signature tensor expansion and Hawkes intensity kernel estimation require high-performance GPU/C++ acceleration.
